definitions.name: Ultrasonic-I2C

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: Write command byte 0x01 to 0x57, wait 120 ms in the official driver, then read three bytes as a big-endian 24-bit distance value. Driver divides the raw value by 1000 for millimeters and optionally by a further 10 for centimeters.

registers.encoding: BE uint24, 1000 raw units per mm

claims: guest driver transaction path and encoding

runtime.blocker: Device-local evidence is required for each firmware and host. AtomS3R/StickS3/StopWatch wiring is admitted for development; their pending host_validation is not a functional PASS. Physical and remaining visual-binding limits remain explicit.

atoms3r.scope: Development wiring admitted from confirmed host pins and shared controller routing. Device-local guest, Web and captured-frame evidence is required before PASS; CoreS3 evidence is not inherited.

sticks3.scope: Development wiring admitted from confirmed host pins and shared controller routing. Device-local guest, Web and captured-frame evidence is required before PASS; CoreS3 evidence is not inherited.

stopwatch.scope: Development wiring admitted from confirmed host pins and shared controller routing. Device-local guest, Web and captured-frame evidence is required before PASS; CoreS3 evidence is not inherited.

definitions.blocker: Device-local evidence is required for each firmware and host. AtomS3R/StickS3/StopWatch wiring is admitted for development; their pending host_validation is not a functional PASS. Physical and remaining visual-binding limits remain explicit.

All default values are synthetic UI/test fixtures, not measured hardware defaults.
This catalog alone does not authorize a simulated or functional-PASS claim.

definitions.output_semantics: Observed guest-to-Unit output; read-only to clients.
